notes.title: ARK and ADE will fully release on March 2, 2023!
notes.notes:
As some of you know, ARK and ADE has been available on App Lab and Steam in early access for a little over a year now. During that time we’ve used invaluable feedback from players all around the world to polish and tweak it, and now we’re finally able to release it on a wider scale. We couldn’t be more thrilled! 😎

[b]We're now happy to announce that we will go into full release mode on March 2, 2023 around 10 am PST / 19:00 CET![/b]

If you've already purchased the game, you will have an update waiting for you at the above time. We're so grateful for your support!

Our store page will additionally have a makeover in the coming days and weeks leading up to the launch. 

For those of you who dont’t know, and are new visitors, ARK and ADE is an action-packed FPS shooter that pulls you (literally) inside an arcade cabinet, where you get to fight bad guys and giant bosses in a neon, retro-futuristic setting reminiscent of the glorious 80’s. It’s easy to get into, but as the saying goes, difficult to master. If you simply want to do some virtual run and gunning, it’s perfect. For those of you who like a real challenge, our Expert mode and leaderboards await!

The price will remain the same as now on launch, there's nothing stopping you from hitting that purchase button now if you'd like to take a peek before the full launch ;)

[b]A short note on the updated content:[/b]
[list]
[*] 🦈 More than double the amount of unique and gnarly bosses. Can you name all the references? 
[*] 🤖 More game modes for 3x the fun. Want an endless amount of stupid minions to shoot at? We got you.
[*] 🏆 Revamped basement. Dude, you're going to love your rad trophy corner.
[*] 📜 The lore. We has it. Collect all the comic pages to learn more about why you're stuck in this basement, and why you're babysitting the cube thing. 
[/list]

Also awaiting are our various social media channels, where we regularly shoot the breeze with our growing community, share ideas and tease updates. See you there!

We hope you’ll enjoy ARK and ADE!

notes.title: Schrodinger Update, ARK-ADE is getting both easyer and more difficult.
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone.

First of all, a little gif of the new boss we're working on. Someone called it Shark-ADE, we love it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305569/138e122d47079ff0f21fc272a4f9499b86fc7460.gif[/img]

In this Schrodinger Update we had a deeper look at difficulty levels.

We had a long conversation about what to change based on difficulty: projectile speed, projectile size, player capsule size, weapon damage, enemy health, ecc... We choose not to modify any of this, ARK-ADE plays quite well as it is and changing what you already know and learned about the game seemed a bit weird.

We'd love you to play ARK-ADE as you always did but giving the chance to new players to enjoy the game and not get frustrated by ADE and the bosses.
At the same time we wanted to give experienced players, the ones chasing the first places on the leaderboards, a more challenging and rewarding game. Expert mode will be a nightmare and a high-score breaker!

[h3]Difficulty changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Normal - This mode should get you through the game without getting mad.
 You'll get the same points as always but boss life is reduced by half.

[*] Hard - for the player who wants a challenge
This mode will be the same as always, in terms of boss life and points.

[*] Expert - for real arcade Gods
You'll get 300% points in this nightmare mode and bosses will have 50% more life than usual.
[/list]

This is the first update of a series that aims to really separate casual gamers from expert high-scoring ones, it will be impossible to get a good placement on the leaderboards playing normal mode. If you want to be up there you'll need to go at least for hard mode. For the top of the leaderboard expert mode will be your only choice.

[h3]Controller angle option[/h3]
You can now calibrate the controller vertical angle to fine tune your aim.

[h3]Added volume reset option[/h3]
This is an easy one and should have been there from the beginning, our apologies.

Small bug fixes.

As always, we want to thank you everyone for your support and your feedback.
ARK-ADE is getting better and better and it's all thanks to you!

Dr. Evil:
"Release the sharks! Mr. Powers, you'll notice that all the sharks have laser beams attached to their heads. I figure every creature deserves a warm meal."

notes.title: Shield and missiles update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

As always thanks a lot for your feedback, it keeps us going on implementing the game and adding new features. We're working hard on every suggestion you gave us, some are more complex to make other are easier, we'll do our best to add them all as we go forward with development.

[h1]SHIELD[/h1]

A brand new companion for the fight against ADE.
You can activate it by holding the grab on your secondary hand. It defends you from anything dangerous in ARK-ADE. I can finally beat some levels in "deux ex cabinet" difficulty level now.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305569/6b6add8dab9d818f6f5d69432c8b8ede015dd4c0.gif[/img]

[h1]MISSILE[/h1]

Still a work in progress, this new turret will shoot tracker missiles that will hunt you no matter what. We highly recommend to take them down instead of avoiding them as they'll come back for you! Shield here is a must have!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305569/0c15f0d479b133bc3817c68efda2a53f805c5719.gif[/img]

Better VFX
Mortar decal now working properly
Other minor bug fixes

notes.title: Release Date reveal.
notes.notes:
We are very excited to announce our release date. It has been a really long journey, 2 years of hard working laughs and tears. When we started a couple of years ago with basically no experience at all in the field we really didn't know if we were gonna make it. Now we can say that the game is almost ready for it's release on the 26th of October. Just a few more things to polish but we're almost there.

We'll most probably be online with the applab version as well on the 26th of October. It just depends on the applab review time, not on our side. As they already reviewed and accepted the demo we're are confident that the final version will be accepted as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40305569/b2b58fe4fae21fb913e8c1c6244a0ecdab3efb8d.jpg[/img]

We're already in the testing phase with some of the greatest people and passionate players we've met during this journey. First feedback received is "The Jungle is brutal" and it is just one of the earliest levels of the game. :) We might need to make it less difficult and accessible for everyone. We'll see how it goes.

If you know any content creator that might be interested in giving ARK-ADE a go please send us an email at info@castelloinc.it or join our [url=https://discord.gg/hQ3GskbsQu]discord[/url] or DM us on [url=https://twitter.com/ARKADE_VR]twitter[/url] we'll be happy to provide you with a key !!!

As always we invite you to join our [url=https://discord.gg/hQ3GskbsQu]discord[/url] if you'd like to chat with us, we're always online... Well when we're not asleep. let's say online most of the time. :)

notes.title: DEMO Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thanks to everyone who tried the game and gave us feedback in the last couple of weeks. It has been great to hear how you enjoyed the game and what wasn't working instead.

We listened to a lot of feedback and we did our best to fix all the weak points and bugs of the game.

So here are some changes in the new version Change log:
- New reload mechanic, faster and more intuitive frees space in the secondary hand to add some ARK interactions and maybe a dual wield powerup in the future. 
- New tutorial which is hopefully clearer in explaining the mechanics of the game.
- Index bindings are fixed now, we got one in house, it should now work properly.
- We changed bindings for all controllers, no grab anymore. We use buttons as a grab seems to be uncomfortable for many.
- We've added an option for faster speed, if you suffer no motion sickness you will be able to go 40% faster.
- Added an option to tweak the rotation velocity as well.
- Machine gun is now an M and not an H (which makes sense)
- Reduced the "headshots" audio during gameplay, it was annoying for some.
- added an icon on text for stopping the game for 10 sec, it gives time to read the story and to take breath.
- fixed some minor graphic bugs.

Down here are some screenshots of the new level, we called it "Adventure". It takes inspiration from indiana jones, tomb raider, the goonies. As you would expect lots of traps, hidden treasures and secret paths.
